title: Reflective Prompt Optimization of a Deep-Research Agent: A Topic-Disjoint, Multi-Seed Protocol for Measuring Transferable Gains and Prompt-Level Overfitting
abstract: arXiv:2610.12601v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prompt optimization is an attractive alternative to reinforcement learning for adapting language-model agents, since it is cheap and produces human-readable artifacts. On factual tasks, however, it carries a failure mode that scalar-reward reinforcement learning does not. An optimizer that reads the training examples can write their answers into the prompt, so an in-distribution gain may be memorization rather than transferable behaviour. We apply reflective prompt evolution (GEPA) to the two system prompts of a multi-agent deep-research agent and evaluate it under a topic-disjoint split in which no topic is shared across train, validation, and test. Held-out citation reward rises by 0.079, from 0.702 to 0.781, with a bootstrap 95\% confidence interval of [0.051, 0.107], and the gain replicates across three seeds (mean 0.107). translated_title: 深度研究智能体的反思性提示优化：一种用于衡量可迁移收益与提示级过拟合的主题不相交、多种子协议
translated_abstract: 提示优化是对语言模型智能体进行适配时一种颇具吸引力的强化学习替代方案，因为它成本低廉且能产生人类可读的产物。然而，在事实性任务上，它存在一种标量奖励强化学习所不具备的失败模式：能够读取训练样本的优化器可能把答案直接写入提示，因此分布内的收益可能只是记忆而非可迁移的行为。我们将反思性提示进化（GEPA）应用于多智能体深度研究智能体的两个系统提示，并在主题不相交的划分下进行评估，即训练、验证与测试之间不共享任何主题。留出集上的引用奖励提升了0.079，从0.702升至0.781，自助法95%置信区间为[0.051, 0.107]，且该收益在三个随机种子上均可复现（平均值0.107）。获胜提示中近一半内容是记忆下来的答案密钥，然而受控消融实验显示这些内容带来了（原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种主题不相交、多种子的评估协议，将反思性提示优化（GEPA）应用于多智能体深度研究智能体，证明其在避免记忆训练答案的情况下仍能取得可迁移的引用奖励提升（+0.079），同时揭示出“提示级过拟合”现象——获胜提示近半内容实为记忆的答案密钥。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a topic-disjoint, multi-seed protocol for applying reflective prompt optimization (GEPA) to a multi-agent deep-research agent, demonstrating transferable citation-reward gains (+0.079) while revealing prompt-level overfitting—nearly half of the winning prompt is a memorized answer key.
